div.h3: Several AIs work on your texts and check each other
div.p: This module translates texts into other languages or proofreads them in their own language. Several language models and translation services work on the same text, then rate each other's results anonymously. A result only counts as agreed when enough of them prefer it. Everything else waits for a human.

ol.li: Providers (menu Providers): switch on the services you want. Free ones need no key; for the others enter your key, press Test connection and activate. Two or more providers give a real cross-check.
Rule (this wizard creates it): which records and fields, which languages, which providers, and which hints (tone, subject area, names that stay as they are).
Search: the rule lists the texts that still need work as proposals. Nothing is sent to a provider yet, so this is free.
Process: on the rule press Process one batch (repeat until done) or switch on the scheduled action for unattended runs. This is when providers are called and costs arise.
Approve (menu Proposals): each proposal shows the candidates, who wrote them, the scores and the reviewers' remarks. Apply the proposal, pick another candidate, type your own wording, or reject it.

ul.li: The surrounding page is given to every provider as context, so single words are understood in their setting. Set the hints and the glossary for technical terms.
Tags, placeholders, numbers and links are checked automatically; a text that breaks them can never win.
Hosted providers receive the texts. Mark a rule Confidential to use only providers on your own server.
Proofreading keeps the original unless a change is clearly better.

div.p: Press Next to create your first rule.

Source language is the language slot in Odoo that holds the original text. If the text in that slot is really written in another language (for example German kept in the English slot), enter the real one under Text is really written in. Only missing skips what is already translated.

field.name: instructions
field.placeholder: e.g. Formal address (Sie). IT company: ISTA+, E-SYS and product names stay unchanged. Search terms in quotes are not translated.

div.p: Leave the providers empty to use every active provider that is ready. A hint about the subject area helps most with single words and short labels.

After creating, press Process one batch on the rule (repeat until the queue is empty), then review the proposals. The rule does not run on a schedule until you switch on Scan and process automatically and the scheduled action.
